plugin_json.description: A Team Lead plus specialist agents, a gated planning pipeline (/forge), a whole-repo bug sweep (/repo-review) and opt-in, local-only guardrails. Every hook stays off until you create a posture file.

agents.name: architect
agents.reason: Upfront design and phase-boundary consultation; reads and plans, writes no production code.

agents.name: backend-coder
agents.reason: Server-side implementation of one focused, testable change.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.reason: Pre-merge review that returns blockers, suggestions and praise.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.reason: Domain-neutral data pipeline, modeling and query work.

agents.name: designer

agents.name: frontend-coder

agents.name: fullstack-coder

agents.name: partner-success-manager

agents.name: project-manager
agents.reason: RAID log, task list and weekly status hygiene.

agents.name: prompt-engineer

agents.name: scout

agents.name: security-reviewer

agents.name: tester-qa

agents.name: viz-spec-reviewer

commands.name: forge
commands.reason: Turns an idea into a gated, two-panel-reviewed, critic-checked plan (runs the forge-pipeline skill).

commands.name: init-agent-ready

commands.name: repo-review

commands.name: dashboard
commands.reason: Opens the hosted posture editor and saves your pasted posture (edition override; the local dashboard server is not included).

hooks.reason: The one setup prompt; speaks only when no posture file exists.
hooks.summary: Prints one fixed line when no posture file exists, saying how to open the posture editor. Writes nothing. Silence it with `RC_DASHBOARD_PROMPT=off` or by creating the posture file.
hooks.ungated_reason: It exists to run when the posture file is absent; it prints one fixed line and writes nothing.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Blocks a tool call that repeats identically 8 times in a row, or any call once a session passes 1,200; both limits, and `runaway: off`, are set in your posture file. Keeps a per-session counter under `.ravenclaude/runs/`.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Warns on `git commit -m` subjects that are not `type(scope): subject` and on new branch names without a standard prefix; `git_protocol: block` makes those blocks, `off` silences it. Never blocks a push. May append to `.ravenclaude/runs/<session>/hook-events.jsonl`.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Denies a write that matches no `allowed_globs` entry in your project's `.repo-layout.json` (nothing happens if you have none). May append to `hook-events.jsonl`.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Advisory text on stderr when an unhedged absolute or causal claim is written into a `knowledge/` or `docs/` markdown file. Never blocks.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Advisory text on stderr when a `knowledge/` or `docs/` file tells the reader to 'open the portal and check' something. Never blocks.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Advisory text when an agent definition (`plugins/*/agents/*.md`) is edited to tell the agent to spawn further sub-agents. Never blocks.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Adds a one-line hint asking Claude to ask one question when a short prompt names nothing concrete. Never blocks or alters the prompt. `ask_on_ambiguity: off` silences it.

hooks.reason: Opt-in, local only, inert until a posture file exists; measured inert and hostile-posture-safe.
hooks.summary: Once per session, reminds Claude to run the project's quality gate if source files changed. Leaves a marker file under `.ravenclaude/runs/`.

deny_globs.reason: Plugin-root constitution; 590 KB and not loaded as project context.
460 KB; history lives in the source repo.
11 MB; hard limit is 5 MiB. Replaced by the hosted portal.
bin/ makes a listing Claude-Code-only and holds claude-launch-guard, which edits shell rc files.
Hooks not in the manifest do not ship; shipped hooks and _-prefixed helpers are exempt below.
Spawns a nested `claude -p`; no shipped component may start another model session.
Tribunal constitution; the tribunal does not ship.
Local dashboard server; the edition has no dashboard.
Routine token reserve: reads a user-configured private GitHub repo.
Documents the routine token reserve, which does not ship.
Posture-driven parallelism/conserve engine; not part of the edition.
Posture-driven parallelism detector; not part of the edition.
Deletes a local branch and pushes a tag to origin.
Handoff nudge engine; the handoff family is not in the first edition.
Writes handoff briefs; its `fill` mode delegates to a nested model.
Documents the nested-orchestrator egress path, which does not ship.
Documents peer-session messaging, which does not ship.
Context meter for the handoff nudge, which is not in the first edition; it reads ~/.claude transcripts.
Model-id catalog used only by the context meter.

closure_allow.reason: A presence test, not a dependency: the script prints the hosted-page wording precisely because bin/rc is absent from this edition.
Docstring mention of a hook that does not ship; the script never opens it.
Docstring pointer to a document about the nested-orchestrator path that does not ship; the script never opens it.

hooks/delegation-nudge.sh.reason: `curl ` is one alternative in a regex that recognises a 'go check it manually' phrase in a document being written; nothing is fetched.

hooks/runaway-brake.sh.reason: `curl`/`wget` appear in a list of command words that mark a Bash call as mutating; the hook only reads the command string.

scripts/apply-comfort-posture.py.reason: `Bash(curl:*)` etc. are permission-rule strings written into .claude/settings.json, and the schemastore URL is the `$schema` value written there; nothing is fetched.

scripts/classify_claim.py.reason: `curl` appears in example sentences used to classify claims; nothing is fetched.

scripts/forge-publish-session-plan.sh.reason: `urllib.parse.quote` only, to percent-encode a file path in a link it prints; no urllib.request.

scripts/premise-gate.py.reason: `curl` appears in example rows and prose of the report it prints; nothing is fetched.

skills/svg-report-lint/lint.py.reason: w3.org URLs are XML namespace identifiers compared against parsed SVG; nothing is fetched.

extra_roots.reason: The /init-agent-ready command names these templates by family (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CI workflows, CODEOWNERS); only one is named by path, so closure alone would ship a command with missing templates.

hook_audit.reason: Programs the shipped hooks are allowed to start. The measured set was awk, bash, cat, cksum, cut, date, dirname, flock, git, grep, head, jq, mkdir, mktemp, python3, rm, sed, tr, wc; the rest are ordinary coreutils that a shell may start on another platform. Anything else (curl, wget, nc, ssh, gh, claude, npx, osascript...) fails the build.

secret_scan_allow.reason: The scrubber's own pattern literal for URLs with embedded credentials, and the example in the comment above it; it is the definition of what to redact, not a credential.
